title: Audio
description: Microphone, pause compression, and feedback sounds. Changes are saved automatically.
device.label: Microphone
device.hint: With “System default,” Wren follows the operating system's microphone. Your choice is kept even if the device is disconnected right now.
compression.label: Shorten long pauses
compression.info: Less audio billed and fewer hallucinations. Turn it off to send the audio exactly as recorded.
compression.hint: Shortens long thinking pauses before sending.
sounds.label: Feedback sounds
sounds.hint: Short tones on start, finish, and error.
